lines.en: - What's that? - 100 ounces of pure palladium.
- Whoa! - It has a street value of nearly $100,000.
Why would you give me something worth this much money?
So you'll do something for me in return.
- What do you want me to do? - Stop dating Sam!
- You can't bribe me to break up with Sam! - But Freddie!
- I really appreciate you letting me spend the night here.
If I had to live with Spencer, I would need a break now and then, too.
By the way, Mrs. Vinson, I love this sofa bed.
It'd be really cool for when Sam spends the night so she could just leave.
You know how I used to give Freddie tick baths?
Well, now I can get rid of ticks with this industrial gasser.
